extensions.name: Argo CD
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Argo CD's Applications, ApplicationSets and AppProjects in a section of their own: sync, health, revision and destination, the resources each application manages with their health, the sync history; Sync, Refresh, Terminate, the diff of desired and live states from Argo CD's API, and the Argo CD UI.

extensions.name: Argo Rollouts
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Argo Rollouts: rollouts with their steps, weights, ReplicaSets and analysis runs; promote, abort, retry, pause and resume with the exact patches of kubectl argo rollouts, shown first; problems of degraded and aborted rollouts and failed analyses.

extensions.name: Argo Workflows
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Argo Workflows: workflows with their phase, progress, duration and failed step, the step tree with each pod's logs, cron workflows and templates; suspend, resume, stop and terminate with the patches the argo CLI sends, shown first; problems of recently failed workflows.

extensions.name: cert-manager
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: cert-manager's Certificates, CertificateRequests, Issuers, ClusterIssuers, Orders and Challenges with their state and reasons, the issuance chain Certificate → CertificateRequest → Order → Challenge, and plain-language explanations of the common failures; problems of Certificates that are not ready, fail to renew, expire soon or have expired. Read-only.

extensions.name: Cluster API
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Cluster API's Clusters, ClusterClasses, KubeadmControlPlanes, MachineDeployments, MachineSets, Machines, MachineHealthChecks and ClusterResourceSets, each with its state from its own phase and conditions; the chain from a Cluster to its Machines, provider objects and Nodes, and the workload cluster opened on a click; problems of failed or unavailable Clusters and control planes, Machines failed or stuck provisioning and blocked remediation. Read-only.

extensions.name: CloudNativePG
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: CloudNativePG: PostgreSQL clusters with their state, instances, primary and switchovers, backups and continuous archiving, scheduled backups and poolers; problems of unhealthy clusters, failing archiving or backups and failed backups.

extensions.name: Contour
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Contour's HTTPProxies, TLSCertificateDelegations and ExtensionServices: each proxy's state as Contour writes it with its first error, its virtual host and TLS, routes with each service's share, includes and the delegation tree; problems of invalid and orphaned proxies. Read-only.

extensions.name: Crossplane
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Crossplane's Composite Resource Definitions, Compositions, Providers, Configurations and Functions with their state, the claims and composite resources of the kinds the XRDs define with the first condition that fails, and the chain Claim → composite → composed resources in the details of claims, composite and managed resources. Read-only.

extensions.name: Dynamic Resource Allocation
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Dynamic Resource Allocation (resource.k8s.io): ResourceClaims with their state, requests (CEL shown as text, never evaluated) and allocated devices, claim templates, device classes and ResourceSlices; the Devices page; the devices of Pods and Nodes; problems of Pods waiting for devices. Read-only.

extensions.name: External Secrets
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: External Secrets Operator: ExternalSecrets, ClusterExternalSecrets, SecretStores, ClusterSecretStores and PushSecrets with their Ready state, the store and its validation, the target Secret, refresh and last sync, and the remote keys by name; problems of failed syncs and invalid stores. It never reads a Secret.

extensions.name: Flux
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Flux CD's objects in a sidebar section of their own: sources, Kustomizations, HelmReleases, image automation and notifications with their readiness, revision and source; what each one applied and which objects use a source; problems of what fails to reconcile; Reconcile, Suspend and Resume.

extensions.name: NVIDIA GPU Operator
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: NVIDIA GPU Operator's ClusterPolicies and NVIDIADrivers with their state, components and DaemonSets and the MIG strategy, a GPU block on GPU nodes and a GPU nodes page; problems of objects not ready, components not rolled out and failed MIG configurations. Read-only.

extensions.name: JobSet
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: JobSets with their state, replicated jobs, restarts against the limit, success and failure policies, Jobs and pods; problems of failed JobSets and of restarts near the limit. Read-only.

extensions.name: k3s / RKE2
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: k3s and RKE2 clusters: a Distribution page with the nodes, the bundled components and ServiceLB, helm-controller's HelmCharts with their install Job and its logs, HelmChartConfigs, k3s Addons and etcd snapshots, and a k3s / RKE2 block on Nodes; problems of HelmCharts whose install failed or keeps failing and of bundled components not available. Read-only.

extensions.name: Karpenter
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Karpenter's NodePools, NodeClaims and node classes: a NodePool's usage against its limits, its disruption settings and the recent disruptions of its NodeClaims, and a NodeClaim's launch, registration and initialization with why Karpenter disrupts it. Read-only.

extensions.name: KEDA
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: KEDA's ScaledObjects, ScaledJobs and TriggerAuthentications: the target, replica range, triggers and state in plain words, the HPA KEDA manages with its verdict and metrics, and where the trigger parameters come from (names only). Read-only.

extensions.name: Knative
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Knative Serving and Eventing: Services, Configurations, Revisions, Routes and DomainMappings with their state, URL, revisions and traffic split; Brokers, Triggers, Channels, Subscriptions, Sequences, Parallels and sources with where they send events and the event path; problems of objects that are not ready. Read-only.

extensions.name: KServe
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: KServe: InferenceServices with their state, URL, model format, runtime, deployment mode and canary share, what KServe made for them and the serving runtime KServe chooses; ServingRuntimes, ClusterServingRuntimes, InferenceGraphs and TrainedModels; problems of models that failed to load, specs KServe cannot serve and InferenceServices that are not ready. URIs are shown without credentials or a query. Read-only.

extensions.name: KubeRay
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: KubeRay: Ray clusters with their head, worker groups and pods, Ray jobs with their entrypoint and submitter, and Ray Serve services with their applications; problems of failed clusters and jobs and of services that are not ready. Read-only.

extensions.name: Kueue
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Kueue's queues and Workloads: ClusterQueues with their quota against what is reserved and in use, LocalQueues, Workloads with why they wait or were evicted, flavors, cohorts, admission checks and priority classes, and the queue of every job Kueue queues; problems of queues that admit nothing and, opt-in, of Workloads waiting too long, not queueable or evicted repeatedly. Read-only.

extensions.name: Kyverno
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Kyverno's ClusterPolicies and Policies with their readiness, mode (Enforce or Audit) and rules, the policy reports with their results, a policy's results over its reports with the objects that fail it, and "Policy results" in the details of every object; opt-in problems of objects that fail policy rules. Read-only.

extensions.name: Service mesh
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Istio and Linkerd: their kinds in sidebar sections of their own with columns and details in plain words, the Request routing page, a Service mesh block on Pods and workloads (membership, mTLS mode, who may call) and Istio configuration problems. Read-only.

extensions.name: Operator Lifecycle Manager
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Operator Lifecycle Manager: Subscriptions with their state and pending upgrades, ClusterServiceVersions with their phase, requirements and Deployments (copies told apart), InstallPlans with their steps, catalogs, OperatorGroups, Operators, and OLM v1's ClusterExtensions and ClusterCatalogs; problems of failed operators, failed or stuck install plans and unhealthy catalogs. Read-only.

extensions.name: OpenShift
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: OpenShift's Routes with their admission and backends, DeploymentConfigs with their rollouts and triggers, BuildConfigs with their builds, Builds with their failure and pod logs, ImageStreams with their tags and Projects, with Rollout latest and Start build; problems of Routes no router admitted, failed rollouts, recent failed Builds and failing imports.

extensions.name: Prometheus Operator
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Prometheus Operator's ServiceMonitors, PodMonitors, Probes, PrometheusRules, Prometheuses and Alertmanagers: what a monitor selects right now and whether its ports exist, which Prometheus picks an object up, a rule's groups, and Prometheus and Alertmanager readiness; opt-in problems of monitors that select nothing and of Prometheuses and Alertmanagers not available. Read-only.

extensions.name: Rook Ceph
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Rook Ceph clusters: Ceph health and its checks in plain words, capacity, daemons, the CRUSH tree and OSDs, pools, filesystems and object stores with their storage classes and claims, charts and problems. Since 1.1.0 it also manages them through Rook's own objects (upgrades, OSDs, CRUSH location, settings, create and delete), every change shown first and confirmed. In every language Sextant has.

extensions.name: Sealed Secrets
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Bitnami Sealed Secrets: SealedSecrets with the controller's Synced state and its error in plain words, the scope they were sealed for, the target Secret and how it stands (from its metadata only), the sealed keys by name and size, and the controller with its sealing keys (metadata only; the certificate is never read); opt-in problems of failed unseals. Read-only, and never a value, sealed or decrypted.

extensions.name: Strimzi
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Strimzi (Apache Kafka on Kubernetes): Kafkas with their listeners and node pools, topics, users, Kafka Connect, MirrorMaker 2 and connectors with their readiness, the connectors' and tasks' states and stack traces; problems of objects that are not ready and of failed connectors and tasks.

extensions.name: Traefik
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Traefik's IngressRoutes (HTTP, TCP and UDP), Middlewares, TraefikServices, TLS options and stores and ServersTransports, of traefik.io and of traefik.containo.us where still served: routes with their entry points and services, settings, and whether every object a reference names exists, with broken references as problems of an opt-in category. Read-only.

extensions.name: Trivy
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Trivy Operator's reports: image vulnerabilities, configuration audits, exposed secrets, RBAC and infrastructure assessments, compliance reports and SBOMs, with their severity counts and most severe findings, and the image scans of every workload. Read-only.

extensions.name: Velero
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: Velero: backups, schedules, restores and storage locations with their phase, errors and warnings, and why one failed in plain words; back up a namespace and restore from a backup by creating Velero's own objects, shown first.

extensions.name: Vertical Pod Autoscaler
extensions.author: Sextant
extensions.description: VerticalPodAutoscalers with their state, update mode and recommendation against the target's template with what a new pod would get, their checkpoints and components, and the VPAs of every workload; problems of VPAs the recommender cannot use, that match no pod or that fight an HPA. Read-only.
